name: Inclusion-Exclusion Set Union Equivalence
description: Replaces the artificial pairwise scoring equation with a single set union cardinality condition. By the Principle of Inclusion-Exclusion, since no task is shared by three employees, |A ∪ B ∪ C| = |A| + |B| + |C| - 3 mathematically implies the sum of their pairwise intersections is exactly 3. Since multigraphs are forbidden, this requires the three employees to form a triangle. Models failing to perform this PIE deduction will attempt O(N^3) set unions and TLE.
